figures.caption: Table 4: Results on LongMemEval. Accuracy evaluated with LLM-as-a-Judge. We report results for SSU, MS, SSP, TR, KU, and SSA, together with the overall score. Values are mean ± one sample standard deviation over R = 5 independent full-pipeline runs. DeMem achieves the best mean overall performance on both backbones and is particularly strong on MS and TR, while some specialized baselines remain competitive on individual categories.

Figure 4: Direct validation of the theory object in the synthetic environment. (a) DeMem learns the lowest-distortion partition; description-aware baselines degrade as mismatch grows. (b) Downstream regret is broadly monotone in induced partition distortion across methods and seeds.
